name: MajlisAlpha UAE Corporate Action Tracker
purpose: Track UAE corporate actions from official disclosures so dividends, board decisions, AGMs, rights issues, capital changes, and trading status events become source-backed research inputs.
eventPolicy: No corporate action should be used in a brief unless the event type, official URL, material dates, issuer impact, owner, and reviewer status are captured.
workflow: classify event type and material dates
link source URL and issuer ticker
record expected model or risk impact
route to catalyst, alert, claim trace, or quality review
mark action research-ready only after reviewer approval

escalationRules.condition: event affects dividend, share count, capital structure, or trading status
escalationRules.action: route to Disclosure Alert Watchtower and Catalyst Calendar

escalationRules.condition: event has missing official URL or incomplete date fields
escalationRules.action: mark blocked and assign Source Refresh Scheduler owner

escalationRules.condition: event changes valuation or peer metrics
escalationRules.action: open Answer Quality Lab review before export

escalationRules.condition: event creates unresolved investment-advice boundary risk
escalationRules.action: send to Compliance Audit Center and keep customer export blocked

launchGate.readyRule: Corporate Action Tracker is pilot-ready when every material action has event type, official URL, dates, ticker, economic impact, owner, and reviewer status.
launchGate.blockedRule: If a corporate action is missing official source path or material dates, it cannot support an exported brief.
